geometric_scaling_hypothesis.statement: Under fixed microscopic threshold g0 and unit box L=1, typical neighbor distance scales as N^{-1/3}; thus A=a_med/g_star is expected to scale approximately as N^{-1/3} if g_star distribution is stable.

notes: This N=750 dataset is provided as a supplementary robustness / N-scaling sanity check for A. It is not used to set locked constants.
Some events have g_star=0 (division singularity); summary stats exclude those events by requiring g_star>1e-12.
